subjects.name: Two-dimensional magnetism
subjects.include: Magnetic order, excitations or control in two-dimensional or layered van der Waals materials as a primary research concern.
subjects.exclude: Exclude general two-dimensional electronics without magnetism and incidental background mentions.

subjects.name: Nonequilibrium quantum dynamics
subjects.include: Nonequilibrium evolution, quenches, thermalization or periodic driving in quantum many-body systems as a primary concern.
subjects.exclude: Exclude classical dynamics and equilibrium phase diagrams without a dynamics question.

subjects.name: Perovskite photovoltaic stability
subjects.include: Stability, ageing, degradation mechanisms or lifetime improvements in perovskite photovoltaics.
subjects.exclude: Exclude LEDs, detectors and efficiency improvements without stability data or analysis.

subjects.name: Solid-state battery interfaces
subjects.include: Electrode interfaces, interfacial reactions and transport in all-solid-state batteries or solid-electrolyte systems as a primary concern.
subjects.exclude: Exclude general liquid-battery SEI studies without a solid-electrolyte or solid-state-battery connection.

subjects.name: Machine learning in catalysis
subjects.include: Machine learning for catalyst design, reaction or adsorption prediction, catalytic simulation or experiment selection, with a contribution to catalysis.
subjects.exclude: Exclude general molecular-property or materials learning without a catalytic object and incidental AI mentions.

subjects.name: Gravitational-wave data analysis
subjects.include: Signal detection, inference, parameter estimation, waveform models for data analysis or noise processing.
subjects.exclude: Exclude hardware-only studies and astrophysics without a waveform or signal-inference connection.

subjects.name: Protein structure prediction
subjects.include: A primary contribution to three-dimensional protein or complex structure prediction, prediction evaluation or structural inference.
subjects.exclude: Exclude downstream use of predicted structures without a contribution to the prediction problem.

subjects.name: Ocean carbon cycling
subjects.include: Marine carbon storage, exchange, transport, biogeochemistry or links to climate as a primary research concern.
subjects.exclude: Exclude terrestrial-only carbon studies and incidental mentions of ocean uptake.

sampling.unit: monitor-work pair after within-monitor work deduplication
sampling.design: simple random sample without replacement per axis
sampling.shortfall: retain actual eligible frame size; no outcome-driven roster/window replacement

transport: anonymous public requests unless a separately documented source configuration is locked; record actual access failures; no original App credentials copied
paper_eligibility: research articles, reviews, methods, analyses, theory and substantive research perspectives; exclude news, editorials and standalone notices; uncertain retained
date_rule: first explicit online publication date, otherwise print date; unknown or contradictory evidence stays uncertain
source_limits_status: Native source limits and completion interpretation explicitly recorded; verify actual attempts at acquisition.
